sentences.l2: 在互联网上，很多人玩同一个游戏。
sentences.l1: On the internet, many people play the same game.

sentences.l2: 这个游戏在虚拟世界里。
sentences.l1: This game is in a virtual world.
You can play together with friends.

sentences.l2: 你们可以合作，一起做任务。
sentences.l1: You can cooperate and do tasks together.

sentences.l2: 比如，一个人开车，一个人看地图，一个人找路。
sentences.l1: For example, one person drives, one person looks at the map, and one person finds the way.
You have to work hard together.

sentences.l2: 其他人也在玩这个游戏。
sentences.l1: Other people are also playing this game.
If you lose, you can play again.
